title: Abba Yose ben Chanan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports in the name of Abba Kohen Bardela. Hyman cites Sifrei Devarim, piska 2, and gives the reading Abba Yose ben Chananyah in Yalkut Devarim at remez השצט [compare 799].

notes.text: The remez printed השצט is anomalous and remains unresolved; no replacement numeral is guessed.

The saved whole Torat Emet Yalkut Shimoni on Torah799 scalar explicitly has Abba Yose ben (Chananyah) [Chanan] in Abba Kohen Bardela’s name. This is a matching799 location alongside the literal anomalous השצט, not proof of a printed ה/ת error or correction history. Both name forms remain; Sifrei Devarim piska2 is not newly inspected, and no identity binding is made.

Hyman’s printed Sifrei locator reads פסוק ב׳. In the corresponding passage in the consulted Sifrei Devarim, piska 2, Abba Yose ben Chanan of Yanoach reports in the name of Abba Kohen ben Delayya. The parallel in Yalkut Shimoni 799 has Abba Yose ben (Chananyah) [Chanan] reporting in the name of Abba Kohen Bardela. Both passages concern how soon Israel could have entered the land.
